mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear at Badger Prairie County Park under a Third Quarter moon, and we are looking at an overnight low of 46 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

October is officially Community Planning Month in Verona. Mayor Diaz issued a proclamation honoring our planning department for their data-driven insights and dedication to public service. Also, remember that the Fireman's Park beach is now closed for the season, though the splash pad remains open.

We have plenty to do today, including the Farley Center Fall Festival, live music at Bailey's Run, and the World Dairy Expo. Looking ahead, you can join the fun at Hop Haus trivia this coming Thursday.

Looking at the records, on September 21, local officers investigated a retail theft involving a subject who stole candy from a store on East Verona Avenue and was later identified through surveillance footage.
Today's delicious flavor is Andes Mint Avalanche. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in just 40 minutes, so be sure to head over before they shut down for the night.
